authority: Single deterministic subprocess persists selected generation, publisher term/permit, durable reader pins and retiring/tombstone state in one envelope. Process-held exclusive byte lock admits one authority. Restart increments writer term and preserves reader pins.
reader_rights: New pins bind current selected generation/revision; existing admitted pins may finish their immutable old generation after publication. Logical retirement blocks new admission, not existing pinned rights.
reclamation: Reclaim only noncurrent generation with zero durable pins; persist retiring intent before deletion; restart resumes an explicitly enumerated idempotent cleanup. Never infer reader death from elapsed time.
trust_boundary: Controller-owned IPC and observed child handle death are fixture authority. No production identity, OS ACL or malicious raw-filesystem writer protection.
alternatives: Drain-before-publish serializes publication after all pins drain; pinned-generation permits new publication while old pins retain generation. Transactional store mapping remains a later comparison, not a selected implementation.
next: Execute source-frozen schedules, retain every failed attempt, synthesize observed limits and pass exact final gates/reviews.
drain_policy: Persist drain intent on busy publication; deny fresh pins while draining, retain status/release processing. Clear intent when publisher is revoked or authority restarts. No global liveness theorem.
publisher_staging: One unique directory per boot/permit serial; stale staged candidates cannot overwrite the selected directory by naming the same generation. Cooperating staged workers stop writing before proposing publication; no OS-ACL or malicious-writer guarantee.
recovery: Restart advances writer term and preserves durable pins. Commit-before-reply is authoritative, not the reply. Interrupted retiring state resumes deletion of the explicit g1 file list; lock file is stable and separate.
lock: Precreated one-byte stable file; offset0 LK_NBLCK exclusion with at most0.5 seconds bounded EACCES retry, not arbitrary OSError retry. Offset1 lock-only helper is an explicitly ineffective exclusion control; no lock file replacement/deletion.
source_scope: Existing CPython3.12.10/Windows/NTFS, no installations/providers/config changes. Runtime and source bytes are prospectively admitted.
